Marissa / Naomi / Elena —

Thanks for the context. A few clarifying points from procurement:
1) Threshold: our temporary invoice-only lane is intended for trials under $5,000 and requires a single-invoice commitment and the signed SOW. TerraLift’s estimate (~$3.5k) fits.
2) Evidence: we need incorporation docs, a W-9 (or equivalent), the signed SOW, and a primary billing contact with direct phone.
3) Risk controls: exceptions are granted for 30 days and automatically expire. Any extension or recurring billing requires converting to a PO-managed agreement.
4) Fasttrack PO: if TerraLift prefers a PO, we can issue a one-off PO in 3 business days if finance confirms billing details and tax docs up front.

Naomi, can you confirm finance is okay to process a single invoice for this pilot once the evidence is provided? Elena, please send the docs to the Drive link and confirm the billing email (finance@terralift.io looks right).

Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference

Elena —

We reviewed TerraLift’s materials and confirmed coverage for the trial under our invoice-only pilot. Approved conditions:
- One invoice covering the pilot amount; payment terms Net 30 after receipt.
- Evidence required in Drive by EOD 6/11: incorporation docs, signed SOW, W-9 (or local equivalent), and billing contact.
- Exception valid through 7/10/2026; any continued usage past that date must be covered by a PO or a renewal SOW that enters standard PO workflow.

Please upload the files to: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/terralift-onboard and reply to this thread once complete so I can route for processing. Once I have the docs I’ll confirm the invoice routing and next steps.
